entries.label: Cover
entries.lesson: Cover key art introduces Electra, Poz, the red ball, the blue ball, and the here-there-back loop.
entries.geometry: Use a simple visible path loop with earlier and later ball positions, but keep the children as natural human children rather than polarity symbols.
entries.background_concepts: Presence, position, path, return, repeated attention.
entries.prompt: Single continuous white playroom scene for a toddler board book cover. Electra and Poz sit on a simple white blanket with purple trim. A red ball and a blue ball sit nearby, with a soft dotted purple path loop showing here, there, and back again. Natural human skin and hair, white and purple clothing, black expressive linework, restricted red/blue/purple geometry only on the balls and path, no arrows, no labels, no in-image text.
entries.palette_rule: Use only pure red, pure blue, red-blue purples, white, and black for non-human visual systems and AAA geometry. Keep scenery, clothing, and tools in white/purple/black unless a red or blue mark is explicitly part of the physics geometry. Human skin and hair may use natural tones.
entries.text_rule: No in-image text, captions, labels, equations, watermark, or logo.

entries.label: Here
entries.story_text:
Here is Electra.

Here is Poz.

Here is the ball.
entries.lesson: The children and the ball are somewhere.
entries.geometry: Electra, Poz, and one ball each occupy clear, separate places.
entries.prompt: Electra and Poz sit close together on a white blanket with purple trim. A red ball rests in front of them, clearly visible and uncovered. The composition makes three simple places readable: Electra here, Poz here, ball here. Natural skin and hair, white/purple clothing, white playroom, black expressive linework, no arrows, no labels, no in-image text.

entries.label: Look
entries.story_text:
A red ball.

A blue ball.

There they are.
entries.lesson: There can be different from here.
entries.geometry: The red ball and blue ball are distinct objects at distinct positions.
entries.prompt: A red ball and a blue ball sit on the white floor a short distance from Electra and Poz. Electra looks toward the red ball while Poz looks toward the blue ball. The balls are pure red and pure blue; the room remains white and pale purple with black linework. Keep the page very simple, no arrows, no labels, no in-image text.

Electra reaches.

Poz reaches.

Toward the ball.

entries.prompt: Electra and Poz both reach toward the red ball on the floor. Their hands point toward the ball without touching it yet. The red ball rolls.

entries.background_concepts: Motion, route, earlier and later positions.

The ball is there.

Electra is here.

Poz is here.
entries.lesson: Here and there can both be held in attention.
entries.geometry: The children remain at the starting place while the ball is visibly elsewhere.
entries.prompt: The red ball rests farther away on the white floor. Electra and Poz remain together on the blanket, looking toward the ball.
